instruction: What is the title of the least played song by Zoey James on Spotify.
notes: Pure information-retrieval task with no database changes, so the only state predicates are knowledge predicates. spotify.search_artists and spotify.search_songs are public endpoints (no access_token), so no spotify.login is modeled and no password/token objects are needed. supervisor.show_profile and supervisor.show_account_passwords appear in the reference solution and are modeled as optional knowledge actions (effects profile-known / passwords-known) that the goal does not require, so an optimal planner may drop them. The artist object zoey-james stands for its runtime artist_id (made usable by known-id after search_artists); the placeholder song object stands for the least-played song whose title is read from the first search_songs result sorted ascending by play_count and passed as the answer to supervisor.complete_task, which must be the final action.
